notes:
Quick summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially for speed to market, clear interest in moving to Dedicated within 6-9 months if unit economics look favorable. Team: Head of Product (Lara Kim), VP Eng (Diego Marquez), infra lead (Aisha Khan). Key quote from VP Eng: "We need a predictable cost model if we move beyond beta — can't have surprise token spend."

POC scope + asks: short proof-of-concept to validate latency on chat/support flows (avg user convo length 120 tokens), embeddings for doc search (1.2M docs), and reranking for search results. Target SLOs: p95 latency for chat < 250ms, embeddings throughput 400 reqs/s, reranking per-request < 150ms. Cost target: reduce per-active-user monthly hosting cost to <$0.50 after caching/batching.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS for key management, data residency: USA-only for support transcripts. Legal has initial redline items on data retention in the security questionnaire.

Workshop request: finance + infra + product to run cost-optimization workshop — cover batching strategies, KV/prefix caching for support histories, recommended quantization profiles (int8 vs q4x), and expected unit economics for Hosted->Dedicated migration. Prospect asked for example delta: "Show us expected cost drop (%) for moving from hosted to dedicated at our volume."

Stubs/links referenced in notes: drive deck (pricing, perf), jira ticket INF-8721 for perf regressions in POC, fireflies ff-2026-02-18-EMB-POC-1 (demo recording).

use_case_summary: Primary: customer support assistant + knowledge base retrieval. Secondary: internal search/rerank to improve relevance for product docs and release notes. Expect heavy embedding reads (1.2M doc vectors) and long tail of short chat interactions. Need deterministic latency for UI snappiness and predictable monthly costs. Interested in using caching for repeating queries, batching at inference layer for embeddings, and model quantization to reduce GPU costs on Dedicated nodes.
